meta.title: feat(persistence): repo-config provenance column on brief (ADR 0032 #8)
meta.body: Adds the repo-config provenance snapshot column to the brief record: migration 0011, drizzle schema, and the artifact-store write path. One commit span from PR #112 (BRIEF-52 worker wiring).
